Guidance & outlook: It is a pleasure to welcome you to our Q1 FY27 Earnings Call.
It gives me great pleasure to say that we have started FY27 on an encouraging note.
Against that environment, our team stayed laser focused on execution, consolidating the channel, driving cost efficiency and strengthening the foundation we built through FY26.
Growth & demand: As the Chairman mentioned, our overall revenue grew by 2.3% year-on-year in Quarter 1, with consumer products growing at 1.7% after a decline for multiple quarters, and lighting solutions grew at 4.4%.
Following a year in which it delivered one of the strongest growth in the industry, a 4.4% growth in this quarter on the top of that stronger base is a credible continuation.

We are confident in our ability to keep raising the bar by driving innovations, expanding our market shares, strengthening our brands and demand generation to deliver consistent and profitable growth.
Margins & costs: From an industry and macroeconomic perspective, the quarter played out against the backdrop of continued input cost inflation, uneven summer demand across categories and the industry largely seeing calibrated price hikes.
However, our EBIT margin improved to 6.6% from 2.5%.
Our EBIT margin improved to 6.6%, a meaningful step up that reflects the operating discipline we have been building over the last several quarters.
Capex & expansion: We have started delivering top-line growth with meaningful margin expansion.
While the cooling products contracted, the non-summer products had a meaningful expansion and double-digit growth across categories.
Moreover, Morphy Richards also grew double-digit post our acquisition in the last quarter.
Balance sheet & cash: This is primarily driven by expansion in our gross margin and efficiency generated on account of operating leverage.
So, our working capital position, see, has improved.
Risks & challenges: Fans, as was mentioned in the opening remarks, saw a decline for us.
In terms of the competition specifically, are you seeing like competition actually getting more intensified, everybody wants to do everything.
Now, will the market share improve or decline or not is a question of how well you play with your brands, your innovations, technology, go-to -market initiatives.

guidance.t: So, once we are off this legacy project, we will go back to double-digit margins in overall lighting.
